pick.name: Affonso
pick.why: Natively supports Dodo Payments and Polar and is the cheapest checked (EUR 15/mo)
pick.free_limits: No free tier; 14-day trial; Launch EUR 15/mo (annual) up to USD 1k/mo partner revenue, Growth EUR 29 up to USD 10k, Elite EUR 79 up to USD 30k; startup programme 50% off yr 1, 25% yr 2, 10% yr 3

alts.what: Link attribution + partner program (Dodo-integrated per Dodo docs)
alts.why: Best if you also want branded short links/attribution; USD 81/mo + 5% payout fee

alts.why: Mature, but supports Stripe/Paddle/Chargebee, not Dodo/Polar natively; USD 99/mo

decision: Don't start an affiliate program until you have a converting self-serve funnel. When you do, Affonso plugs straight into Dodo/Polar for EUR 15/mo.
details: Dodo's docs list Affonso, Dub Partners and Rekomi integrations.

verify.note: Supports Stripe, Paddle, Polar.sh, Creem and Dodo Payments (confirmed). No free tier, 14-day trial, startup 50/25/10% over 3 years. The EUR 15 Launch plan is capped at USD 1,000/mo partner revenue.
